meta.name: OpenEco Demo
meta.description: Open-source emissions accounting platform demo instance
meta.author: OpenEco Team

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenEco Demo Installation Script

# Install Node.js dependencies (if needed)
if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
  npm ci --production
fi

# Generate Prisma client
npx prisma generate

# Run database migrations
npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss

echo "OpenEco Demo installation complete"

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the demo database

variables.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Secret key for NextAuth.js session encryption (min 32 characters)

variables.name: NEXTAUTH_URL
variables.description: Public URL of the demo instance (e.g., https://demo.open-eco.org)

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.description: Public URL for the application (same as NEXTAUTH_URL typically)
